policy: V11 keeps post-close economic refund/chargeback adjustment v1 unchanged and adds a separate exact-entry prior-period accounting-error correction path. Historical ReportingEntry, LedgerEvent, AccountingClose and PeriodClose objects remain immutable. The correction is a new evidence-bound opposite entry excluded from current-period realized P&L and marked for later restated-period presentation.

additions.authority_note: Human/multisig EXACT_ENTRY_VOID authorization for a proven prior-period accounting error. It binds original PeriodClose/AccountingClose/LedgerEvent/ReportingEntry, immutable period ancestry, correction evidence and target accounting-policy/requirement-registry context. Posting is separate, AI authority is NONE, and the resulting ledger entry is excluded from current-period realized P&L.
